title: Members group photo (with club banner)
alt: South East Queensland Defence Veterans Golf Club members gathered at the tee beside the club banner, Gold Coast Open Day
notes: The money shot: whole group, club feather banner visible. Best for the About page and a strong hero option. Consent to publish confirmed by the club, 3 August 2026.

title: Tee overlooking the water hazard
alt: Two club members at the tee looking down the fairway toward a water hazard on a clear morning
notes: Good on-course atmosphere shot. Suits a portrait feature slot or gallery. Photographer's shadow is in the lower foreground; it overlaps the right-hand player's feet, so it cannot be fully cropped out. Framed slots crop from the top edge to minimise it.

title: Golfer on the tee, hillside fairway
alt: A club member addressing the ball on the tee with a grassed hill and gum trees behind
notes: Face is obscured under the cap. Clean scenery shot, safe to use without consent concerns.

title: Four-ball on the tee (scenic wide)
alt: Four club members lined up across the tee preparing to play, with a scenic fairway and bushland beyond
notes: Strong wide scenic, a good full-width hero. The on-disk copy has had the Facebook viewer chrome cropped out and is clean to ship, but it is a slightly soft video frame. TODO: request the original full-resolution frame from the album and swap it in.

title: Tee shot with shot-tracer
alt: A club member mid-swing on the fairway, the ball's flight traced by a red arc
notes: Fun action moment, but the red shot-tracer arc is baked into the image and clashes with the duotone treatment. Use only as a playful gallery accent, or source the original clean frame without the overlay. Do not use as a hero.
